name: KitchenMate RO + UF (Undersink)
summary: Sleek and compact RO Water Purifier for your modular kitchen. ZeroB Kitchenmate is a sleek and stylish water purifier which enhances the aesthetics of your kitchen, as well as, does not occupy kitchen counter space that comes with a complimentary long-reach faucet.
intro: The ZeroB Kitchenmate RO Water Purifier is a sleek, compact under-counter water purifier designed for modern modular kitchens. It features a 7-stage RO purification system, 8-liter storage capacity, and a complimentary long-reach faucet, delivering safe and purified drinking water while saving valuable countertop space.
features: Sleek under-counter design for modular kitchens
Space-saving installation with complimentary long-reach faucet
Purifies water with TDS up to 1500 ppm*
Bacteriostatic activated carbon filter for improved taste and odor
10-micron sediment filtration for effective particulate removal
Ideal for small to medium-sized families
Compact and stylish design that enhances kitchen aesthetics
